pcb.via_covering_note: Plugged (JLC replaced Tented with Plugged free of charge, 2026-09-23; Tented is greyed out on the quote page with 'The Via Tented option is upgraded to Via Plugged for free.' -- fab/jlc_cart_2026-09-23_y9/02_via_tented_upgraded_to_plugged.jpg). JLC describes Plugged as solder-mask ink pushed into the hole through an aluminium sheet, then the whole board printed; plugging rate over 98 % excluding vias in pad (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-via-covering, read 2026-09-23). No fill or cap: the barrel is not treated as closed, and ACCEPTANCE I keeps every via out of the pads.
pcb.ipc_4761_note: JLC's help page and blog (jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-via-covering, jlcpcb.com/blog/five-via-finishes, read 2026-09-23) do not map Plugged to an IPC-4761 Type, and the standard itself is not read here (harness KS-032). Not guessed. Until 2026-09-23 this file said Tented / Type I (as commonly described).
